address: 3 rue de la République, Wissembourg, 67160, France
bio: In the heart of Little Venice, this former local butcher's now draws crowds of diners keen to tuck into the creations of the chef – truly passionate about ingredients, he pays tribute to his suppliers by displaying their names. Here, the ultimate experience is to dine on the terrace on the banks of the Lauter, or inside with a view of the Église St-Pierre-et-St-Paul....
